title: Taskboard batch close with result in one call
requirement: The owner can accept a batch of review tasks in one task_close call, supplying the result and evidence in that same call; a close fills missing result fields and never rewrites a summary already recorded, and every refusal is reported per task.
reason: The owner stated the requirement in chat on 2026-11-12; the automated proof is scripts/taskboard-close-stop-proof.mjs and will be linked once it has a red-first run.
steps: Create review tasks, some with a complete result and some without.
Call task_close once with ids plus resultSummary/resultEvidence (or a per-task results array).
Read the returned per-task results and the ledger.
expected: Every task with review status and a complete result after the fill closes to done in one board write; a task still missing summary/evidence is refused by needs_result/needs_evidence and stays in review.
